slides.title: How do you know the change is real and not just talk?

body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.
Three games tonight: standing, guarded, pinned. Win one and the next round gets harder. Lose it and you run the same one again.
Single Leg Takedown to Hip Connection Game
Skill Learning Objective (SLO): Entering, for both players.
Both players stand. The attacker holds one of the defender's legs, somewhere from knee to ankle.
Attacker: move the defender, work out to the ankle, and use foot-to-foot contact to put him down on his hips or hands. Defender: free the leg, then grab one of the attacker's legs, knee to ankle.

items: The attacker wins when the defender is down on his hips or hands.
The defender wins by freeing the leg and then grabbing one of the attacker's legs.

body.text: Post and Hook Continuous Connection Game
The top player is standing. The bottom player is belly up with hooks on the top player's body and both hands on his ankles.

Top player: clear both feet to the outside for shin-to-body contact, or lock your hands from hips to shoulders. Bottom player: keep at least one hook and one hand connected at all times, using only posts and hooks to keep putting the top player on his butt or hands.

items: The top player wins by getting outside with shin-to-body contact, or by locking his hands from hips to shoulders.
The bottom player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps his connections.

body.text: SLO: Controlling for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The top player is behind the bottom player with chest-to-back contact, both arms and both legs connected.
Top player: keep chest-to-back contact by following the bottom player and keeping your hands connected. Bottom player: put your back on the mat or turn to face.

items: The top player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps contact.
The bottom player wins by getting his back to the mat or turning face to face.

slides.title: How you win it
slides.question: In Chest to Back Control Game, what wins it for the top player?

options.text: The top player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps contact.
options.feedback: That is the win condition, and nothing else scores.

options.text: Holding the finish after your partner taps
options.feedback: Never. You let go the second your partner taps. Every single time. The tap is law.

options.text: Hurting your partner because you can
options.feedback: That is the one thing the Back Pin teaches you never to do. Total control, plus the choice not to hurt someone, is the heart of the whole program.

slides.correctText: That is how you win today.

body.text: Tested change is change you can trust.

A change that only works when it is easy is not a real change yet. Holding the back against a fighting partner puts it to the test. Who you have become gets proven the same way, by whether it holds up when things get hard.
